unit.title: Checkpoint practice papers
unit.subject: Mathematics
unit.note: Written by the Atomic teaching team in the format of Cambridge Lower Secondary Checkpoint Mathematics (0862). Not Cambridge papers.

NUM.t: Number: integers, powers and roots, fractions, decimals, percentages, ratio and proportion

ALG.t: Algebra: expressions, equations, inequalities, sequences, functions and graphs

GEO.t: Geometry and measure: angles, shapes, area and volume, Pythagoras, bearings and transformations

STA.t: Statistics and probability: averages, charts, scatter graphs and probability
